atlas:
Use case: logo-brand. Produce ONE 3 by 3 atlas of flat monochrome interface glyphs for the Neuroshima virtual tabletop RPG, matching image 1 strictly for STYLE AND FORMAT ONLY. Do not copy any reference subject. Exactly equal square cells, no drawn grid lines or labels. Pure solid WHITE shapes on a perfectly clean solid BLACK background. No grey, other colors, shading, gradients, texture, outlines around a white shape, speckles, distress, text, lettering, numbers, music notes or logos. Serious utilitarian object silhouettes, broad black negative-space cuts, restrained detail readable at 16 screen pixels. Each complete glyph centered inside its own cell, at most 75% cell width/height, generous black margin and separation, nothing crossing a cell edge. EXACT row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
CELL 1: A compact drum motif: one broad drum, one cymbal on a short stout stand and two thick crossed drumsticks. Sparse black cuts; no complete sprawling kit, player or fine hardware.
CELL 2: One saxophone with an unmistakable curved J-shaped tube and wide upturned bell, short bent mouthpiece and three broad key bumps. No player, tiny keys or engraving.
CELL 3: One electric violin with a narrow open skeletal violin-shaped frame and a short neck, plus one separate stout diagonal bow. Distinct small violin waist and complete bow, no player or fine strings.
CELL 4: Submerged status: a simple adult HEAD silhouette fully BELOW one stout WAVY WATER SURFACE LINE, with TWO large round bubbles rising beside the head. Clear black gaps between head, line and bubbles. No face detail, scenery or text.
CELL 5: Drowning status for a game: ONE anatomically coherent raised adult HAND protruding ABOVE a single stout wavy WATER SURFACE LINE, with ONE broad DOWNWARD ARROW beside it. Exactly four fingers and one thumb, grouped simply, intact wrist below the waterline. No person, face, extra hand, tiny droplets or text.
CELLS 6, 7, 8, 9: completely EMPTY SOLID BLACK; no glyphs, filler, ornaments or duplicate objects.
One clear complete subject per active cell. Maintain the exact layout.
